text: The Nominating Panel – Administrative Penalty Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate currently serving as member of the Administrative Penalty Tribunal as Chair to City Council for appointment to the Administrative Penalty Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Administrative Penalty Tribunal recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate, currently serving as member of the Administrative Penalty Tribunal, as Chair of the Administrative Penalty Tribunal for a term of office ending on July 15, 2025, and until a successor is appointed: Sancia Pinto 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 4 to the report (June 20, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Administrative Penalty Tribunal.
